semiconductor_relevance: High — SEBONG provides critical automation and material handling solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: SEBONG specializes in advanced automation solutions for semiconductor production, focusing on equipment and materials that enhance manufacturing efficiency. Their offerings include transfer systems for wafers and reticles, material handling systems, and technologies for mask making, including polymer masks and nanoimprint lithography templates.
capabilities: Transfer systems for wafers and reticles
Material handling systems for conveying and processing
Polymer masks and templates for nanoimprint lithography
Robotics solutions for coat, develop, and resist processing
